items.term: what a routine declares it needs

listings.label: operation
listings.caption: The path of one operation, here a bias pulse. Obtaining the handle checks the capability, the handle's method names an action, and the executor the handle passes it to reports its start and its end to the event bus

listings.label: backends
listings.caption: The same operation behind the controller interface. The interface asks a backend for its capabilities, gives an optional operation a default that reports it unsupported and leaves a required one without a body; the Nanonis backend translates the bias pulse into a call of the protocol client, and the mock backend records it

listings.label: tip-prep-setup
listings.caption: What tip preparation declares to the harness: the settings it needs in place for the run and how the tip is left afterwards

listings.label: tip-prep-loop
listings.caption: The cycle of tip preparation, the main loop of its `run` method
